body:
**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** #281 and #282, reconciled with #280

## Outcome
Demonstrate how the O1 design expands to adjacent O1/O2 without pushing routing/service difficulty into a giant middle board.

## Deliverables
- Use actual adjacent panel geometry and three-front/two-rear octave-selector arrangement; include rear cards, existing rear terminals, controls, support, latch/connector insertion, extraction, wiring, probe/tool and rear-cover envelopes.
- Verify O1/O2 paths remain local, non-crossing where practicable, with shared power/reference and continuous returns assigned. Reconcile mechanical connector placement with task 02 ownership and task 04 budgets.
- Compare core-only versus functional architectures at identical functionality, including harness count, conductor total length, crimps, all mating contacts, dedicated hardware, assembly operations and replacement steps. Source baseline O1 = 11 harnesses/51 conductors; five OSC = 55/255. Whole instrument currently 195 harnesses/911 fitted conductors/1,822 crimps plus 18 separately listed main power wires; these are baseline counts, not promised removable quantities.
- Separate test-adapter wiring from final product connections. Identify whether one rear electrical design is repeatable and which mechanical/connector variants remain necessary.
- Record representative one-zone middle-board test-piece plan and adjacent-two fit evidence requirements. No whole-instrument motherboard routing before these gates.
- Assess applicability to later VCF/VCA, ENV/offset and utilities only at boundary level; do not assume OSC success covers all 33 functions or propose one PCB per function without evidence.

## Acceptance
No unowned obstruction, extraction path or shared-service crossing; exact unresolved dimensions/tolerances flagged. Comparison identifies genuine burden reduction or a reason to revise. Independent mechanical/service reviewer can reproduce the fit analysis; physical qualification stays open (#55/#65).

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
